description: This Java source file defines the CorsEnablingDirective class, which provides an Akka HTTP directive for enabling CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) on wrapped Routes, based on specific HTTP request headers and configuration.

classes.name: CorsEnablingDirective
classes.description: Provides a directive to enable CORS for Akka HTTP routes based on HTTP request headers and a configuration setting.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of CorsEnablingDirective with the specified HTTP configuration.

methods.name: enableCors
methods.description: Wraps a given Route with CORS enabling logic, setting appropriate headers based on request headers and configuration, enabling cross-origin resource sharing.
